transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 428 Gretna Green Drive?

I hear you’re both here at 428 Gretna Green Drive. Sorry about that. What should I fix?
Actually, my husband is here with me—he needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. I’m the one who should be helped.

I hear you’re with your husband who needs oxygen. Let me read that back: 2 people; husband needs help leaving because of oxygen; husband needs help leaving because of help leaving because he’s on oxygen; no water inside yet. Is that right?
No, just one person here — me — and my husband needs oxygen, but he can’t leave alone. No water inside yet.

I heard you’re here with your husband needing oxygen. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.
